```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# GO Slim ORA dotplots and CSV export (BP / CC / MF)
# Publication-style plots with adjusted p-values shown as 10^-25, 10^-20, etc.

# Libraries -------------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(DOSE)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Paths -----------------------------------------------------------------------
input_dir  <- "3. Volcanoplot"
output_dir <- "4. ORA_dotplots"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
input_file <- file.path(input_dir, "deseq2_results_filtered.csv")

# Load differentially expressed genes ----------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
genes_ensg <- unique(df$gene_id)

# Map Ensembl IDs to Entrez IDs
gene_map <- bitr(
  genes_ensg,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)
entrez_genes <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)

# Download and parse the GO Slim generic ontology -----------------------------
slim_url <- "https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/subsets/goslim_generic.obo"
slim_obo <- readLines(slim_url)
term_starts <- which(slim_obo == "[Term]")

slim_info <- lapply(term_starts, function(i) {
  block     <- slim_obo[i:min(i + 25, length(slim_obo))]
  id_line   <- grep("^id: GO:", block, value = TRUE)[1]
  name_line <- grep("^name: ", block, value = TRUE)[1]
  ns_line   <- grep("^namespace: ", block, value = TRUE)[1]

  if (!is.na(id_line)) {
    data.frame(
      GOID      = sub("^id: ", "", id_line),
      name      = sub("^name: ", "", name_line),
      namespace = sub("^namespace: ", "", ns_line),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

message(
  "GO Slim terms loaded: ", nrow(slim_info),
  " (BP=", sum(slim_info$namespace == "biological_process"),
  ", CC=", sum(slim_info$namespace == "cellular_component"),
  ", MF=", sum(slim_info$namespace == "molecular_function"), ")"
)

slim_by_ont <- list(
  BP = slim_info %>% filter(namespace == "biological_process"),
  CC = slim_info %>% filter(namespace == "cellular_component"),
  MF = slim_info %>% filter(namespace == "molecular_function")
)

# All propagated GO annotations
go_data <- AnnotationDbi::toTable(org.Hs.egGO2ALLEGS)

# GO Slim ORA -----------------------------------------------------------------
run_go_slim <- function(ont_code) {
  slim_ids <- slim_by_ont[[ont_code]]
  ont_map  <- c(BP = "BP", CC = "CC", MF = "MF")

  term2gene <- go_data %>%
    filter(go_id %in% slim_ids$GOID, Ontology == ont_map[[ont_code]]) %>%
    dplyr::select(go_id, gene_id) %>%
    distinct()

  term2name <- slim_ids %>%
    dplyr::select(GOID, name) %>%
    distinct()

  res <- enricher(
    gene          = entrez_genes,
    TERM2GENE     = term2gene,
    TERM2NAME     = term2name,
    pvalueCutoff  = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff  = 1
  )

  if (!is.null(res)) {
    res <- setReadable(res, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  }
  res
}

ego_BP <- run_go_slim("BP")
ego_CC <- run_go_slim("CC")
ego_MF <- run_go_slim("MF")

# Export complete enrichment tables ------------------------------------------
save_go_csv <- function(ego, ontology_label) {
  if (is.null(ego)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  if (!nrow(ego_df)) return(invisible(NULL))

  write.csv(
    ego_df,
    file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("GOSlim_", ontology_label, "_results.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

save_go_csv(ego_BP, "Biological_Process")
save_go_csv(ego_CC, "Cellular_Component")
save_go_csv(ego_MF, "Molecular_Function")

# Publication-style dotplot settings -----------------------------------------
plot_significant_only <- TRUE   # FALSE = top 20 regardless of significance
plot_fdr_cutoff       <- 0.05
plot_top_n            <- 20L
plot_width_in         <- 4.5

# Legend formatter: -log10(p.adjust) values of 5, 10, 25 are displayed
# with plotmath as 10^-5, 10^-10, 10^-25 (superscript exponents).
# Plotmath avoids font/encoding problems in exported PDF files.
scientific_p_labels <- function(x) {
  parse(text = paste0(
    "10^{-", as.integer(round(x)), "}"
  ))
}
make_go_dotplot <- function(ego, ontology_label) {
  if (is.null(ego)) {
    message("No GO Slim results for ", ontology_label)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  go_df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  if (!nrow(go_df)) {
    message("No GO Slim terms for ", ontology_label)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Filtering is plot-only; all results remain in the exported CSVs.
  go_df <- go_df[!is.na(go_df$p.adjust), , drop = FALSE]
  if (isTRUE(plot_significant_only)) {
    go_df <- go_df[go_df$p.adjust < plot_fdr_cutoff, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (!nrow(go_df)) {
    message("No terms pass the plotting threshold for ", ontology_label)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  go_df <- head(go_df[order(go_df$p.adjust), , drop = FALSE], plot_top_n)

  # Convert GeneRatio from '53/576' to 53/576.
  go_df$GeneRatio_num <- vapply(
    strsplit(as.character(go_df$GeneRatio), "/", fixed = TRUE),
    function(z) {
      if (length(z) == 2L) as.numeric(z[1]) / as.numeric(z[2])
      else NA_real_
    },
    numeric(1)
  )
  go_df <- go_df[is.finite(go_df$GeneRatio_num), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(go_df)) return(invisible(NULL))

  # Break long GO term names over multiple lines.
  go_df$Term <- vapply(as.character(go_df$Description), function(x) {
    paste(strwrap(gsub("\\s+", " ", x), width = 30L), collapse = "\n")
  }, character(1))

  # Place GO terms with the largest GeneRatio at the top.
  go_df <- go_df[order(go_df$GeneRatio_num), , drop = FALSE]
  go_df$Term <- factor(go_df$Term, levels = unique(go_df$Term))

  # Use -log10(p.adjust) for the colour scale; actual p-values are unchanged.
  go_df$neg_log10_padj <- -log10(pmax(go_df$p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin))

  count_breaks <- pretty(range(go_df$Count), n = 3)
  count_breaks <- count_breaks[
    count_breaks > 0 &
    count_breaks >= min(go_df$Count) &
    count_breaks <= max(go_df$Count)
  ]

  plot_title <- paste("GO Slim", gsub("_", " ", ontology_label), "Enrichment")

  p <- ggplot(go_df, aes(x = GeneRatio_num, y = Term)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = Count, fill = neg_log10_padj),
      shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.28
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Count", range = c(1.8, 4.6), breaks = count_breaks
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      name   = "Adjusted p-value",
      low    = "#4E8DBD",    # less significant = blue
      high   = "#D65A5A",    # more significant = red
      breaks = function(limits) {
        ticks <- pretty(limits, n = 5)
        ticks[ticks >= limits[1] & ticks <= limits[2]]
      },
      labels = scientific_p_labels
    ) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "GeneRatio", y = NULL) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(
        order = 1, direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top",
        barwidth = grid::unit(4.5, "cm"),
        barheight = grid::unit(0.22, "cm")
      ),
      size = guide_legend(order = 2, title.position = "top", nrow = 1)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 5)),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E6E6E6", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#B7B7B7", linewidth = 0.35),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.box.just = "left",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.15, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 4, b = 3, l = 4)
    )

  plot_height_in <- max(3.5, 2.0 + 0.20 * nrow(go_df))
  file_stub <- paste0("GOSlim_", ontology_label, "_dotplot")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".pdf")),
    plot = p, width = plot_width_in, height = plot_height_in,
    units = "in", device = "pdf"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")),
    plot = p, width = plot_width_in, height = plot_height_in,
    units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white"
  )

  message("Saved ", ontology_label, " plot (", nrow(go_df), " GO terms).")
  invisible(p)
}

# Export BP, CC and MF dotplots as PDF + high-resolution PNG -----------------
make_go_dotplot(ego_BP, "Biological_Process")
make_go_dotplot(ego_CC, "Cellular_Component")
make_go_dotplot(ego_MF, "Molecular_Function")

message("GO Slim enrichment complete. Results saved to: ", output_dir)

```
